title: tanacetum corymbiforme
intro: Tanacetum corymbiforme, commonly known as Tansy, is a perennial plant in the sunflower family (Asteraceae) native to Eurasia and North Africa. The plant has been used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiparasitic effects, as well as its use as a natural insect repellent. The therapeutic actions of Tanacetum corymbiforme include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve digestive issues, and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of Tanacetum corymbiforme include thujone, santonin, and borneol, among other compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
